rules.name: Phishing Link Detection
rules.description: Detect credential harvesting links in email via URL reputation
rules.aql_query: SELECT * FROM events WHERE EVENT_TYPE = 'Authentication' AND OUTCOME = 'SUCCESS' AND SOURCE_IP NOT LIKE '10.%' AND (USERNAME LIKE '%admin%') LAST 15 MINUTES
